Container.Name: zapconvert-media-worker
Container.Overview: Audio, video, GIF, PDF to Word and PDF to Excel conversions for ZapConvert (ffmpeg, pdf2docx, PyMuPDF). It has no published port: only containers on the zapconvert network can reach it. Files are processed in RAM and deleted after each job. Licensed AGPL-3.0; the source is served by every ZapConvert instance at /source/zapconvert-media-worker.zip.
Container.Requires: Create the network once in the Unraid terminal: docker network create zapconvert

Config.Name: Worker token
Config.Description: Optional shared secret. Must match Media worker token in the zapconvert container.

Config.Name: Concurrent jobs
Config.Description: Conversions run at the same time. Raise on hosts with many cores.

Config.Name: Job timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: A conversion running longer than this is stopped.
